scenes.title: Before the Eyes
scenes.summary: The poet should see the scene as if present, as Carcinus failed to do with Amphiaraus, and the play failed.

scenes.title: The Gifted and the Mad
scenes.summary: He should act out the feelings with gestures: poetry belongs to the gifted or to the mad, the one adaptable, the other carried away.

scenes.title: The General Outline
scenes.summary: Set out the story in general terms and then add names and episodes: the outline of the Iphigenia, with Orestes' madness and the purification as its proper episodes.

scenes.title: The Story of the Odyssey
scenes.summary: The Odyssey's story is short: a man long away, watched by Poseidon, his house wasted by suitors, comes home, reveals himself, and destroys his enemies; the rest is episodes.
